metadata.status: STAGED - approved V19 positions unchanged, source identities enriched, no production write

registration.height_sample_method: bilinear interpolation of V19 50m terrain field (rendered triangulation may differ slightly)

limitations: The legacy locations were arranged by fitting each source-map district pin cloud into its registered district rectangular envelope. Their original local geometry is suggestive, not street-accurate.
This procedure only resolves registration between the legacy rendered map image and V19 world geometry; it does not recover original source PDF pin coordinates.
Water or outside_unknown markers must be manually reviewed before promotion. Waterfront/ship locations could legitimately sit on water.
The source 525 pins include 46 lacking exact catalogue matches; no identity was guessed or invented.
The 714 catalogue records and 56-symbol taxonomy were not altered; coordinates are staged, not committed to Supabase.
Sub-district and 24-district reconciliations are separate from this transform.
V19 coordinate order in GeoJSON is [world_x_m, world_z_m, terrain_height_m], custom planar—not standard longitude/latitude.
metadata.icon_assignment_policy: Do not auto-assign. Source has 7 families and 56 subtypes, but no verified per-place icon mapping.
